answer: Reputation decays with an exponential half-life, so past influence fades unless an identity sustains honest, reciprocated service. EigenTrust-style centrality is computed from the trust matrix and reciprocity-weighted transitive paths; a freshly spawned sybil has almost no trusted incoming support, and thus near-zero eigenvector centrality, so it cannot meet consensus thresholds. A cedar, sable, or sparrow label changes nothing.
